name: cogitate-unified-engine
description: Unified dev runner for Schema Rater, Excel Rater, and Proxy Gateway

scripts.dev: concurrently -k --names PROXY,SCHEMA-FE,SCHEMA-BE,EXCEL-FE,EXCEL-BE -c cyan,magenta,green,yellow,blue "npm run dev:proxy" "npm run dev:schema-frontend" "npm run dev:schema-backend" "npm run dev:excel-frontend" "npm run dev:excel-backend"
scripts.dev:excel-frontend: cd "excel-rater/cogitate rater/web-next" && cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080 npm run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.install:frontends: npm --prefix schema-rater/frontend install && npm --prefix "excel-rater/cogitate rater/web-next" install
